name: Suzu○ Haruhi no Hanmon
source:
"W, wait, Kyon! You don't really remember anything?"

An idea came up in my mind to spoof our leader for the fun of it.

However.

"I let you do anything you like with me"

While saying so, the leader started to take off her clothing.
And the situation got worse as this fray involved Nagato and Miss Asahina.

Why you are not here, Koizumi!?

*A short story featuring Haruhi and SOS Brigade members.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032696.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“等、等等，阿虚！你真的什么都不记得了吗？”

我突然想到一个主意，想开个玩笑捉弄一下团长。

没想到，事情却发展成了这样。

“我任你为所欲为。”

团长说着，开始脱衣服。接着，长门和朝比奈也被卷了进来，场面愈发失控。
古泉，你为什么偏偏不在这里！？

一篇以凉宫春日和SOS团成员为主角的短篇故事。

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032696.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
